objective: Read-only tree-reduce source review where independent mappers feed intermediate reducers before one final decision.

steps.task: Map the runtime source relevant to the parent-copied review question. Do not edit or run commands. Return component, owner, canonical path, evidence, risk, and unknowns.
Map README, skill, cookbook, examples, and public tests relevant to the parent-copied review question. Do not edit. Return docs owner, promised behavior, mismatch risk, and missing proof.

Review tests and fixtures relevant to the parent-copied review question. Do not edit or run commands. Return what behavior is covered, what is helper-only, what denial branches are missing, and residual proof gaps.

Reduce runtime and docs mapper evidence into one source-contract packet: survivor owner, conflicting promises, affected paths, and smallest safe next action. Preserve contradictions instead of resolving them silently.
Reduce test mapper evidence into one proof packet: public behavior covered, expected denials covered, helper-only proof, missing gates, and residual risk.

Combine the intermediate reducers into a final tree-reduce decision. Return recommended action, evidence rows, conflicts, validation gaps, and what a narrower follow-up graph should inspect if needed.
